title: Page 271
transc:
No 1.  2.30 P. M.
W. R. Plum Eastport Miss.  Wash Jan. 19 1865
Henrietta Hope Lady unity Judah has directed that no
more panama spaffords be sent to your pontiac till 
the proposed Roman airy salem of Leopard's is supplied
zebra legend has been ordered to collect all his
nutmeg saint at some vernon on the gulf &
to tambour against Gilead & Emblem zodiac Its the
wish of John that your opal should cooper - platina 
by tannering upon the same Vernons pekin few leghorns
ready in time pedlar or that if this cannot
be done that allure whisky not required for Quack
should be sent tooth Gulf to hopper - paddle with paddle with
Lehigh on that line unity Its understood that honduras
has gone Wilson to bring the remains of Hudson's
oyster to avon to oppose Kennebec zebra If so
leopards can easily reach Egypt & if not his
talbot will hold handle in check & keep him
away from Kidnap Zodiac Herald please plainfield your views
upon these proposed hopper - wales pedlar stating what line
you purpose toothache looking at Glasgow as the objective
Vernon & by what date harp be ready to
tablet pekin or few doughnut propose a winter paxton
pain from your present bass pedlar state hominy spit
you can send tooth Gulf unity This Sweden is
tarquin in order that Juno may give his final
instructions for winter hopper - wales zebra If Hudson comes
tooth cost he will probably leave behind apart of
hospitals pacific tomahawk raids & demons - wales pekin but
they will not be enough to do any
serious in - jury Jordan Don't use feeble column always
